name: Overall Performance
query: SELECT id, ROUND(pass_rate, 2) AS "Pass Rate", ROUND(time_used, 1) AS "Time", total_tasks AS "# Questions" FROM (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY id ORDER BY pass_rate DESC, time_used ASC) AS rn FROM (SELECT results.participants.agent AS id, (SELECT 100.0 * SUM(res.score) / NULLIF(SUM(res.max_score), 0) FROM UNNEST(results.results) AS r(res)) AS pass_rate, (SELECT SUM(res.time_used) FROM UNNEST(results.results) AS r(res)) AS time_used, (SELECT SUM(res.max_score) FROM UNNEST(results.results) AS r(res)) AS total_tasks FROM results)) WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY "Pass Rate" DESC, "Time" ASC;
